settings.question: Who can get the student discount?
settings.answer: Anyone in UK further or higher education with a free, verified Student Beans account.

settings.question: How do I use my code?
settings.answer: Tap Get Code, sign in or sign up with Student Beans, then enter the code in the discount box at checkout. 15% comes off your order.

settings.question: Do I still get the 60-night trial?
settings.answer: Yes. Your duvet still comes with free UK delivery and our 60-night trial, so you can sleep on it before you decide.

settings.heading: Larke, for every kind of sleeper
settings.intro: We believe everyone should feel remarkable in their sleep. We've partnered with Student Beans to offer students a discount, making natural sleep that little bit easier to enjoy.
